collection_rule: Four sequential foreground HTTP requests, one per index, no retries, no price-dependent stopping; no fixed interval or statistical independence asserted. Preserve failures and interrupted attempts.
fee_basis: Alpaca lowest-volume public taker fee reserved in received asset on all three legs; not account-verified.
clock_threshold_status: Diagnostic choices, not exchange execution guarantees or measured order latency.
invalid_book_rule: Reject absent, crossed, nonpositive or duplicate-price levels; retain stale/skewed books only as hypothetical snapshot arithmetic.
capital_interpretation: Each size is a separate nonexecuted diagnostic; $2000 uses entire capital and no extra reserve, hence optimistic. No simultaneous allocation.
limitations: Continuous quantities; account pair permissions, minimum sizes and rounding unverified.
No guaranteed book survival, atomic fills, failure unwind or output fee debit timing.
No historical performance or annualization; samples correlated and selected after prior research.
